title: feat(core,react,app-shell): action confirmText, successMessage and errorMessage read the template envelope and fill {{ }} holes (objectui#13367)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuT1VQkBzUTyDsEUih9AXFHq)_

Fixes #13367

The renderer half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#24814 (ruling A): an action's `confirmText`, `successMessage` and `errorMessage` read the `template` envelope and fill `{{ }}` holes, before the spec types the three slots as `template` slots. Claim: #13367 comment `6369803045`.

## What changes

- **`ActionRunner`** (`@object-ui/core`) reads each key as a string or `{ dialect?: 'template', source? }`:
  - `confirmText`: `{{ }}` holes over `record` (the record the action runs against; on a list, the clicked row, the same rule as `templateEvaluatorFor`) and `params` (the action's static params object, without the stashed row; the collected values do not exist yet when the confirmation shows);
  - `successMessage`: `{{ }}` holes over `result` (the payload `${result.*}` reads) and `record`;
  - `errorMessage`: no root is declared yet, so the text shows as written.
- **The engine** is `@objectstack/formula`'s `templateEngine`, the one the flow notifications render with and the one #13183's ruling names. It is exported at this repo's `.objectstack-sha` pin and already a dependency of `@object-ui/core`. No engine and no hole grammar is written here.
- **Transition:** a sentence with no `{{ }}` hole keeps today's reading (`${…}` through `ExpressionEvaluator` for `confirmText`, `${result.*}` for `successMessage`), so the platform objects' `${result.email}` sentences keep working until the spec card converts them.
- **One dialect per sentence:** a sentence with a `{{ }}` hole goes through the template engine only. A record value that happens to contain `${…}` is never evaluated after it was filled into a hole.
- **No object reaches a React child:** an envelope with no string `source` gives `''` to the confirm handler (the declared confirmation still gates the run), the default text to the success toast, and the action's own error to the error toast.
- **`useActionTextLocalizer`** (`@object-ui/react`) kept the three keys as `I18nLabel` maps and collapsed them with `pickLocalized`, which turns `{ dialect: 'template', source }` into its first string value: the word `template`. It now hands the envelope on, and a bundle entry replaces its `source` (i18next leaves a missing `{{ }}` variable in place, measured on the installed version).
- **Flow actions** (`@object-ui/app-shell`): `flowSuccessCopy` read the invoking action's `successMessage` only as a string, so an envelope fell to the flow's own copy. It now reads it through `actionCopySource`. `FlowRunner`'s `actionSuccessMessage` takes the same two shapes (the type widening made app-shell's type-check red at the two launch sites otherwise).
- `@object-ui/core` exports the reader: `ActionCopyTemplate`, `isActionCopyEnvelope`, `actionCopySource`, `hasTemplateHoles`, `fillTemplateHoles`.

Clause-②: yes (the claim said `no`; `ActionDef`'s three keys widen and core gains five exports, so this declares the widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## Tests

- New `packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.copyTemplate-13367.test.ts` (28): a plain string and an envelope per key; each root (`record` from the header and from a row, `params` without `_rowRecord`, `result`); a formatter; an undeclared root prints empty; `${…}` still filled for `confirmText` and `successMessage`; one dialect per sentence for both; a refused source shown as written; an envelope with no source for each key; `outcomeMessages` still outranks; an envelope counts as declared copy for a navigation (objectui#12755); the reader helpers.
- New `packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/useActionTextLocalizer.templateEnvelope-13367.test.tsx` (5): nameless and named actions keep the envelope, a bundle entry replaces `source`, a sourceless envelope passes through, strings and maps unchanged.
- `packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/flowResponse.test.ts`: 3 new cases for the envelope on a flow action.
- Ablation (on `f25bc24`): the localizer's `collapseCopy` put back to `pickLocalized`, and the success rung put back to string-only: 9 failed (5 runner, 4 localizer); restored with `git checkout HEAD -- packages`, `git diff --quiet HEAD` clean.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/core/ packages/react/` → 331 files, 5566 passed. `packages/components/src/renderers/action/ packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/ packages/app-shell/src/utils/ packages/plugin-grid/` → 391 files, 3995 passed. After the app-shell commit: app-shell hooks, utils and flow views → 141 files, 1427 passed. After merging `origin/main` (`889d028`): core actions, react hooks, flowResponse and the objectui#13379 navigator pins → 84 files, 1097 passed.
- `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/console` → 37/37. A first run over app-shell, console, components and the plugin packages went red on the two launch sites above, which the second commit fixes.
- eslint on the touched files: 0 errors. Gates exit 0: `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`. `check:readme-exports` needs every package built and was left to CI.

## Order

This PR → objectstack's `.objectui-sha` moves past it → objectstack-ai/objectstack#24814 types the slots (it carries `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#13367`).

## Serial

objectui#13395 (objectui#13384) also edits `ActionRunner.ts`, in other hunks (a refusal inserted just above the confirm read, and the `RUNNER_TEXT` docblock, whose last sentence this PR rewords). Whichever lands second merges main.

## Acceptance notes

- `{{ }}` formatters render in `en-US`: the runner has no language (its docblocks say so), so `{{ amount | currency }}` does not follow the user's locale yet. Noted, not filed.
- `FlowRunner`'s terminal toast after a paused flow shows the action's copy as written: neither `{{ }}` nor `${result.*}` is filled there, before or after this PR. Noted, not filed.
- The Studio action inspector and preview (`ActionDefaultInspector`, `ActionPreview`) read the three keys as `I18nLabel` maps, so an envelope would show there as `template`. Authoring surface, outside the runner; noted, not filed.
- #13183 (bulk `confirmText` fill step, `baozhoutao`) can call the same `fillTemplateHoles` over `{ count, … }`; this PR does not touch plugin-grid.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
